title: Personio pricing - $5-$20/employee/month across Essential, Professional, Enterprise
clean_text: Personio does not publish list pricing; quotes depend on employee count, modules, contract length, and country requirements. Reported figures put pricing in the $5-$15/user/month range across three tiers -- Essential (10-100 employees, core HR), Professional (100-500 employees, adds automation), and Enterprise (500-2,000 employees, complex multi-country HR) -- with other sources citing roughly EUR5-8/employee/month for core HRIS and EUR12-20/employee/month for the broader suite. Implementation costs range from $1,000-$5,000, and add-ons like advanced analytics or third-party integrations can add $50-$500+/month.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, per-employee per-month, custom quote
